title: Root node vulnerable to version-bump demotion attack
description: In lichen-rpl/src/dodag.rs, process_dio() allows any peer to demote a DODAG root by sending a DIO with a higher version number. When a root receives a DIO with version > current, it calls adopt_version() which transitions the root to Unjoined state and joins behind the attacker. Per RFC 6550, only the root should originate version increments. Fix: roots should either reject DIOs entirely or ignore version upgrades from peers. Impact: network routing takeover, traffic interception, DoS. Attack requires authenticated network access.
close_reason: Already fixed: process_dio() already rejects all DIOs when role==Root (lines 343-346), with SECURITY comment documenting the mitigation. Test root_ignores_newer_version_dio verifies the behavior.
